mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS MoM change declines by more than 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a contraction in the real economy that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1000 thousand units), rising home construction signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
